# Global Premium Events (GPE)

> Global Premium Events is a 100% women-owned international events and missions company headquartered in Rabat, Morocco. It organizes B2B missions and business matchmaking in Africa, official delegations, investment forums, trade show stands and corporate events across Africa, the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), Europe and the United States. Founded and led by Sarah Zineb Boumouja, Co-Founder & CEO. Award: "Best Global Event Management Company – North Africa", MEA Markets African Excellence Awards 2022.

Key facts:
- Headquarters: 12 Rue Dar El Beida, Hassan, Rabat, Morocco (relocating soon)
- Contact: info@globalpremiumevents.com · +212 653512995 · CEO: ceo@globalpremiumevents.com
- Languages: English, French, Arabic (interpreters for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and other languages on request)
- 12+ years, 8,000+ participants and delegates, 45+ countries represented
- Serves companies from Africa, China, Japan, South Korea, the Gulf, Europe and the Americas that want to do business in Africa

## Services
- [B2B missions and business matchmaking in Africa](https://globalpremiumevents.com/services/missions-partnerships/): trade missions, pre-arranged B2B and B2G meetings, official delegations
- [B2B missions calendar](https://globalpremiumevents.com/missions/?lang=en): upcoming business missions to Africa and the Gulf
- [Africa business missions for Japanese companies (日本語)](https://globalpremiumevents.com/africa-business-japan/)
- [Africa business missions for Korean companies (한국어)](https://globalpremiumevents.com/africa-business-korea/)
- [Africa business missions for Chinese companies (中文)](https://globalpremiumevents.com/africa-business-china/)
- [Trade show stand design and exhibitions](https://globalpremiumevents.com/services/exhibitions-trade-shows/)
- [Corporate event production](https://globalpremiumevents.com/services/event-production/)

## Case studies
- [Africa Trade & Investment Global Summit 2018, Washington D.C.](https://globalpremiumevents.com/case-study-trade-mission/): organizing partner; 2,345 delegates from 92 countries
- [Zimbabwe at the Sharjah FDI Forum 2018](https://globalpremiumevents.com/case-study-sharjah-fdi-forum/): official investment mission, country stand, investor matching
- [Africa Health Business Symposium IV, Addis Ababa 2019](https://globalpremiumevents.com/case-study-africa-health-business-symposium/): VIP and delegation management, session moderation
- [1st African Purple Economy Forum, La Mamounia, Marrakech 2016](https://globalpremiumevents.com/case-study-purple-economy-forum/): officially labelled COP22 event

## About
- [About and CEO biography](https://globalpremiumevents.com/about-us/#ceo-bio): Sarah Zineb Boumouja, speaker and moderator on Africa–Gulf investment, women's leadership, inclusive events and cultural diplomacy
- [Global Inclusive Events](https://globalinclusiveevents.com/): accessibility and inclusion initiative with Indiana University's Kelley School of Business
